title: Rosemary Beach:Blu Nest in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Blu Nest in Rosemary Beach. Overlooking North Barrett Square
description_expanded:
Featuring a private 40-foot balcony wrapped around North Barrett Square. Throw open the plantation shutters and let the sea breezes drift in, while enjoying the heart and soul of Rosemary Beach.

This dramatic second floor flat has two bedrooms, two baths, and is perched atop the Hidden Lantern Gallery and Bookstore.

An efficient cook’s kitchen offers open shelving, Bosch appliances, and connects to a bright and welcoming living area.

Children and young adults will delight in the open guest room, outfitted with twin bunk beds and a private en suite bath. The master bedroom offers a stylish, restful sanctuary, with direct access to the shuttered wrap-around porch.

The perfect getaway for 2-4 guests.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
